passages.en: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

passages.en: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

passages.en: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
